source: Is it weird that I’m proud of not crying in front of my son? Gavin said some of the other first-graders called him Captain Hook because he has a one-eyed “pirate mom.” He was all huffy and puffy when I picked him up and he asked how I could let someone poke out my eye... 'why didn’t you fight back?' Real Me wanted to shout that I’m fighting back every day… but Mom Me told him, again, that some things are sad accidents and we can learn to accept them or be upset all the time. I said the next time someone talks about my eyepatch, tell them a silly pirate joke. There's one I remembered from grade school: 'What's a pirate's favorite letter? I'll give you R but it's really the C! ' He held back a smile... This scar still finds ways to haunt me…"

source: “Not do it,” they say. “So dumb,” all agree. Big group: cousins and siblings clumped together with me. All hide under leaf, clumped for heat. Could freeze if not. Time of cold air. But I have question. They never question. They: eat daisies, mate, hide, sleep, eat daisies, mate, hide, sleep, on and on. Me: what there on top of mountain? “Make way,” I say and fly. I fly up and up, through many tree, wings whirr strong, follow long slope up. Only bug in air is me. I worry – what if hungry bird watches? I fly up and up. Less tree and more wind the more up I go. Wind and cold make wings harder to move, antenna lose feeling. But I see top close ahead so I push hard. Then it happen: big cold wind. Wing, front leg, middle leg, back leg – whole body stop from cold as wind carry me up and over mountain top. I am prisoner of wind but sight… amazing. I see bigness and smallness at same time, how sky and cloud go everywhere forever, how rock and tree and water share the wild ground. Beauty I not know could be. Sight blurs, body saying "I done." Ah well, nice to see a perfect thing. I wake in ground needle where wind drop me. First, excited: I alive, can tell family of the perfect! Then, sad: home… where? “Hey, ant!” I say. He stop and put down leaf in mouth, he turn to me. “I saw all of ground and sky, the bigness and smallness, was so perfect!” “So what?” he grunt, and take his leaf to eat, then mate, hide, sleep.
target: 「别去，」他们说。「笨死了，」大家都同意。 一大群，表兄弟姊妹、兄弟姊妹，跟我挤一起。全躲叶子下，挤在一起取暖。不这样会冻死。现在是空气冷的时候。可是我有问题。他们从来没问题。 他们：吃雏菊，交配，躲藏，睡觉，吃雏菊，交配，躲藏，睡觉，一直重复。我：山顶上有什么？ 「让路，」我说，然后飞走。我往上飞，一直往上，穿过好多树，翅膀用力振，沿着长长山坡往上。空中只有我一只虫。我担心——要是有饿鸟看着呢？我还是一直往上飞。越高，树越少，风越多。风和冷让翅膀越来越难动，触角没感觉了。但我看到山顶就在前面，所以更用力。然后来了：一阵好大的冷风。 翅膀、前脚、中脚、后脚——全身冻得不能动，风把我卷上去，越过山顶。我成了风的囚犯，可眼前……太惊人。我同时看见巨大和渺小，天空和云朵到处延伸，直到永远，石头、树、水共享荒野的大地。不知道世上能有这种美。眼前模糊，身体在说：「我不行了。」啊，能看到完美的事物，真好。 我在地上的松针堆里醒来，风把我丢在这。先是兴奋：我还活着，可以告诉家人那份完美！然后难过：家……在哪？ 「喂，蚂蚁！」我说。他停下，把嘴里的叶子放下，转向我。「我看到了整片大地和天空，巨大和渺小，真的好完美！」 「所以呢？」他咕哝，拿起叶子去吃，然后交配、躲藏、睡觉。
